questions.question: Who was the founder of the People's Republic of China?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Mao Zedong was 'the founder of the People's Republic of China'.
Incorrect. Sun Yat-sen is mentioned as a republican figurehead, not the founder of the PRC.
Incorrect. Deng Xiaoping succeeded Mao later, but he is not described as the founder.
Incorrect. Hua Guofeng initially succeeded Mao, but he is not the founder.

questions.question: In which year did Mao Zedong die?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Mao died in 1976.
Incorrect. 1949 is the year the PRC was founded, not Mao's death.
Incorrect. 1966 is when the Cultural Revolution was launched, not Mao's death.
Incorrect. 1935 is when Mao became leader of the CCP, not his death.

questions.question: What was the name of the campaign Mao launched in 1966?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states 'In 1966, Mao launched the Cultural Revolution'.
Incorrect. The Great Leap Forward occurred from 1958 to 1962, not 1966.
Incorrect. The Hundred Flowers Campaign was a brief period of liberalisation before the Cultural Revolution.
Incorrect. The Long March was a military retreat in 1935, not a campaign launched in 1966.

questions.question: Where was Mao Zedong born?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Mao was born 'near Shaoshan village in Hunan'.
Incorrect. Beijing is where Mao later worked as a librarian, not his birthplace.
Incorrect. Changsha is where Mao studied, not his birthplace.
Incorrect. Shaanxi is where the Yan'an Soviet was located, not Mao's birthplace.

questions.question: Which political party did Mao help found in 1921?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states 'In 1921, Mao became a founding member of the CCP'.
Incorrect. The Kuomintang was the rival party, not the one Mao helped found.
Incorrect. The Chinese Socialist Party was founded by Jiang Kanghu, not Mao.
Incorrect. The Bolshevik Party was the Russian communist party, not Chinese.

questions.question: What strategy did Mao help develop for the Chinese Red Army?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Mao 'developed a strategy of guerrilla warfare'.
Incorrect. Naval blockade is not mentioned in the article.
Incorrect. Nuclear deterrence is not mentioned as a strategy Mao developed.
Incorrect. Trench warfare is not mentioned in the article.

questions.question: What happened to the Nationalist government after Mao defeated it in 1949?
options: It withdrew to the island of Taiwan
It surrendered and joined the CCP
It fled to the Soviet Union
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says the Nationalist government 'withdrew to the island of Taiwan in 1949'.
Incorrect. The Nationalist government did not surrender and join the CCP.
Incorrect. The Nationalist government did not flee to the Soviet Union.
Incorrect. The Nationalist government did not remain in Beijing.

questions.question: Which campaign aimed to collectivise agriculture and industrialise the country from 1958 to 1962?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states 'Mao oversaw the Great Leap Forward, a campaign that aimed to collectivise agriculture and industrialise the country'.
Incorrect. The Cultural Revolution was launched in 1966, not 1958-1962.
Incorrect. The Hundred Flowers Campaign was a period of liberalisation, not industrialisation.
Incorrect. The Long March was a military retreat, not an economic campaign.

questions.question: Under Mao, the PRC replaced the Republic of China as a permanent member of which international body?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says 'the PRC replaced the Republic of China as a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council'.
Incorrect. The World Health Organization is not mentioned in this context.
Incorrect. The International Monetary Fund is not mentioned in this context.
Incorrect. The World Trade Organization is not mentioned in this context.

questions.question: What was Mao's role in the Chinese Communist Party when he became its leader in 1935?
options: Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party
General Secretary of the United Nations
President of the Republic of China
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Mao served as 'Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party' and became leader during the Long March.
Incorrect. Mao never held a position at the United Nations.
Incorrect. Mao was not president of the Republic of China; he founded the PRC.
Incorrect. Mao was not commander of the Kuomintang; he fought against them.
